Level 21+: 9-12 |difficulty = |duration =30 minutes |notable loot = }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Map of Tarkov|location]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. It is the tenth map that was added to the game. ==Description== The business center of Tarkov. This is where TerraGroup was headquartered. This is where it all began. The area has yet again become a hot zone since the early days of the conflict. ==Notes== Matchmaking on this location is divided into beginners (Level <21) and experienced players (Level 21+). For groups, matchmaking is based on the highest level player in the group. In experienced matchmaking there are the following differences: * Chance to find rare loot * Increased [[Scavs]] difficulty * [[Cultists]] can appear ==Features== *Stationary weapons in the form of [[AGS-30 30x29mm automatic grenade launcher]]s and [[NSV Utyos 12.7x108 heavy machine gun]]s. *Be aware of [[Map of Tarkov#Minefields|Minefields]], [[Map of Tarkov#Claymores|Claymores]] and [[Map of Tarkov#Border Snipers|Border Snipers]]! ==Usable Keys== {| class="wikitable sortable" !Icon !Key Name !Used in Quest |- ![[File:TerraGroup science office key icon.png|link=TerraGroup science office key]] |[[TerraGroup science office key]] ! style="color: green" |✔ |- ![[File:Underground Parking Utility Room Key Icon.png|link=Underground parking utility room key]] |[[Underground parking utility room key]] ! |- ![[File:United Credit Bank Cash Register Key Icon.png|link=Unity Credit Bank cash register key]] |[[Unity Credit Bank cash register key]] ! |} ==Bosses== {{Seasonal change|[[Black Division]] can occasionally roam through the level 21+ version of the location.
